maintenance_message: Vet-Rate.org is currently undergoing critical maintenance to protect your data. Please check back in a few hours. Follow us on Twitter @VetRateOrg for status updates.

changelog.title: 📡 VA API Status Monitor - 'The Lighthouse'
changelog.description: Real-time VA API status monitoring! When VA systems (Blue Button, Health Records, Appeals) are down for maintenance, you'll see a banner - so you know it's not us, it's them.

changelog.title: 💻 Tablet Optimization - 'The iPad General'
changelog.description: Full iPad and tablet support! Smart device detection, orientation-aware layouts, and enhanced save prompts for Files app/cloud storage integration.

changelog.title: 🛡️ CRASH-PROOF STORAGE - 'The Bunker'
changelog.description: Your data now survives browser crashes and cache clears! Click 'Save My Packet' to create a crash-proof file on your device that auto-saves as you work.

changelog.title: 🎮 GPU Selection for Dual-GPU Systems
changelog.description: Laptops with dual GPUs can now choose which GPU runs Local AI! Force 'High Performance' for speed or 'Power Saver' for battery life in Faraday Cage settings.

changelog.title: Save-As-You-Go Protocol
changelog.description: Every form field, every claim, every statement now auto-saves within 1.5 seconds. No more lost work!

changelog.title: Resume Packet Feature
changelog.description: Coming back tomorrow? Click 'Resume Packet' to load your saved file and pick up exactly where you left off.

changelog.title: Live Operations Protection System
changelog.description: Added automatic data migration system to protect your saved data during updates

changelog.title: Update Notifications
changelog.description: App now checks for updates every 15 minutes and notifies you when a new version is available

changelog.title: What's New Modal
changelog.description: See exactly what changed in each update with our new changelog system

changelog.title: Version Tracking
changelog.description: Comprehensive version management ensures compatibility and smooth upgrades

changelog.title: Cache Busting
changelog.description: Hard reload when updating ensures you always get the latest code, not cached versions
